name: Checkout: negative qty -> coupon replay -> token replay -> unthrottled
goal: Demonstrate revenue-layer abuse: broken quantity math, reusable coupons, replayable single-use tokens, all unthrottled.
preconditions: Cart/checkout/coupon endpoints on any commerce surface.
impact: Direct monetary loss; free orders and unbounded coupon/token reuse.

steps.skill: web/Negative quantity accepted in cart totals
steps.purpose: Prove total math accepts non-positive quantities (money manipulation).
steps.on_success: Document the total-diff proof; try coupon stacking next.
steps.on_fail: Qty sanitized -> other numeric fields (price, discount, shipping, currency).

steps.purpose: Coupon replay proves missing uniqueness enforcement on 'single-use' claims.
steps.on_success: Pair with step 4 for unbounded replay.

steps.purpose: No throttle = the abuse scales without resistance; also the prerequisite for true races later.
steps.on_fail: Throttled -> document separately; slow-abuse within budget.

steps.purpose: Generic single-use token replay (OTP/invite/transaction) — the transferable proof.
steps.on_success: Mechanism-level finding: uniqueness enforcement absent app-wide.
steps.on_fail: Token rigid -> client-side price/total tampering (documented variant).

recon.name: Totals diff matrix
recon.how: Send quantity/price mutations and diff server-computed totals vs client display.

recon.name: Replay harness
recon.how: Replay every one-time request verbatim; count accepted repetitions.

recon.name: Encoding ambiguity probe
recon.how: Quantities as strings ('1e2'), arrays, nested objects — parsers normalize differently.

recon.name: Flow-state skipping
recon.how: Jump checkout steps (call confirm directly); missing state machines accept.

variants: true parallel races (documented gap: burst executor)
pivot_hints: pair with auth chains for full fraud narrative
coupon APIs often in OpenAPI specs (info_disclosure)
document mechanism-level finding (uniqueness absent) for max severity
